visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with an extreme close-up of a person's mouth where a small metal screw is being unscrewed from the gum line. A circular magnifying overlay highlights the procedure. Yellow captions appear on the screen. (2) A man wearing a black beanie and a grey denim shirt sits in a bright, modern dental office with white marble walls. He talks with a doctor while gesturing toward his mouth. (3) The man lies down on the dental chair as the doctor, wearing green scrubs and a mask, adjusts the surgical light. Bright icons and musical note emojis float on the screen as the procedure starts. (4) Detailed shots of dental pliers removing wires and screws from the man's mouth are shown. He appears to be in slight discomfort, squinting his eyes and opening his mouth wide while the doctor works precisely. (5) After the successful removal, the patient sits up and gives a thumbs up to the camera while the doctor takes a commemorative photo with a digital camera. The man sticks his tongue out playfully at the end.

A light, upbeat acoustic-style background music track plays at a moderate tempo. The doctor's voice remains low and calm. (3) Background chatter and light laughter from a female voice are audible as the procedure continues. The music remains consistent while the man's vocalizations become more exaggerated and comedic, punctuating the perceived pain. (4) A digital 'ding' sound effect plays as the removal is completed. The man's tone shifts to a more relaxed and positive valence while discussing the recovery with the doctor. (5) The video concludes with the doctor congratulating the man in a friendly, authoritative tone. The music swells slightly before a hard cut as the man makes a final playful noise while sticking out his tongue.
